card.name: Quantities of food and goods
card.fires_on: Numbers and quantity words (3, one, a, three) that start an amount of food or goods, in historical rations, old recipes or tax lists. It fires right before a unit like lb, oz, shekel or a measure of salt.

modes.label: Ration amounts
modes.description: A number starting a weight of food in a list of rations or allowances.
modes.example: rations included: - <<3>>/4lb Pork for each man twice

modes.label: Recipe quantities
modes.description: A quantity word such as a or three in an old recipe, before a measure of an ingredient.
modes.example: mix<< a>> quarter of an ounce of beaten mace

modes.label: Fractional payments
modes.description: A number or fraction word in a tax or allowance amount.
modes.example: a capitation tax of<< one>>-half shekel each from the adult men
